task_name: Camp construction and visual upgrade system
purpose: Machine-readable contract for dependency-safe T11 preparation plus isolated build-pending work. It does not authorize final integration or approval before T10 is accepted.

dependency_gate.final_activation_base: exact integration head containing T10 APPROVED/integrated completion record

build_pending_contract.t10_binding_mode: semantic mock/adapter against frozen T10 public contract
allowed: source-bound evidence not claiming final T10 compatibility
blocked_until_t10_accepted: final T08/T09 through-T10 resource conservation evidence

reference_acceptance_moments.observed: Dense blue-white conifers, winter field, harvesting/animal encounters, carried resource stacks and a construction pad.
reference_acceptance_moments.t11_acceptance: Preconstruction world must preserve a readable in-world construction pad and surrounding winter-field context without replacing T09 harvesting behavior.
reference_acceptance_moments.scope_boundary: T11 owns pad/content presentation only; harvesting/acquisition remains T09.

reference_acceptance_moments.observed: A fenced warm/brown-floor camp appears with central heated vessel/fire, stock pads/counter area and separated approaches.
reference_acceptance_moments.t11_acceptance: Initial constructed camp visibly changes the playable area and contains authored work-floor/station composition with clear access lanes while preserving the approved T03 perimeter/gates.
reference_acceptance_moments.scope_boundary: T05 assets may be reused; T11 does not rewrite their source art or duplicate T03 perimeter authority.

reference_acceptance_moments.observed: Stock delivery, payments, pad spending, upgrade burst and a larger/more numerous orbiting axe attack.
reference_acceptance_moments.t11_acceptance: T11 must prove the ground-pad commit can drive a visible camp/world upgrade with truthful before/transition/after presentation.
reference_acceptance_moments.scope_boundary: Payment/customer logic is later work; weapon/attack upgrade is T21, not T11.

reference_acceptance_moments.observed: Stockpiles grow while camp pads/lanes remain readable and field harvesting continues outside the gate.
reference_acceptance_moments.t11_acceptance: Every completed T11 camp stage must preserve readable gates, work lanes, pads and outside-field continuity under the approved camera.
reference_acceptance_moments.scope_boundary: Stock quantity growth belongs to inventory/production systems; T11 only proves spatial/readability compatibility.

required_content_roles.source_family: T05 passive composition bindings where needed; behavior remains later-owner controlled
T05 exact direct binding pad_upgrade + T11 authored camp upgrade content

camp_recipe_schema.shipping_price_rule: Every shipping recipe must contain price_source or tuning_record provenance. Observable video labels and unrelated historical furnace/barricade costs may not be generalized into T11 prices.
camp_recipe_schema.test_fixture_rule: Non-shipping fixture costs must be explicitly marked test-only and cannot be silently promoted to shipping content.
camp_recipe_schema.t10_authority_rule: T11 may bind build-pending fixtures to semantic T10 contract IDs but may not implement alternate debit, atomicity, idempotency or transform-state authority. Exact accepted T10 IDs/interfaces must be reconciled before INTEGRATION_READY.

required_route_checks: player can enter/exit through required gate in every camp state
required T03 work lanes remain traversable
approved T04 camera does not clip or hide the actionable pad/result
T07 contextual control behavior remains single-joystick/proximity driven
temporary transition collision/FX are removed after commit
